metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (AIRS2SUP_NRT 7.0): a self-relation, which should be removed.
No PARENT, INPUT, CHILD or RELATED associations; this run proposes 1 PARENT, 3 RELATED.
No ATBD in RelatedUrls (decision branch [2]); the AIRS L2 ATBD could be linked alongside the User's Guide.
TemporalExtents begin 2002-08-30, but NRT products are a 7-day rolling archive and its input AIRIBRAD_NRT begins 2015-12-15.
